description: This file defines a custom Android UI component 'TvChannelCard' that extends CardView. It displays information about a TV channel, including program title, channel info, live badge, rent badge, progress bar, and a play button overlay. The class provides methods to bind TV channel data to the view for rendering UI elements dynamically.

classes.name: TvChannelCard
classes.description: Custom view representing a TV Channel card with program info, live badge, and play button. It is optimized for Android TV with D-pad navigation and overscan-safe margins. Provides a bind method to populate data from a TvChannel object.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a TvChannel data object to the view, updating all UI elements to reflect the channel's details.
